name: Performance Foodservice - Denver
old_description: At Performance Foodservice — Denver, we’re more than just a food distributor. With a national presence and local expertise, we bring you the best of both worlds. Our commitment to quality, innovation, and reliability makes us the trusted partner for over 2,000 customers across Colorado, Wyoming, and New Mexico. We’re here to drive your success, one delivery at a time.
about:
Performance Foodservice – Denver operates from Henderson, Colorado, tracing its lineage to 1885 when James Capers founded Pocahontas Foods in Virginia. That company later became Performance Food Group (PFG), a Fortune 500 corporation. The Denver division took shape through a series of mergers: Vendor Supply of America (founded 1970 by Alan and Gerald Marcove), Roma Distribution (1955), Donsons Distributing (1957), and Leprino’s restaurant supply division (1994). In 2005, Vistar Corporation and Roma Foods merged to form Roma Denver, which was folded into PFG after Blackstone and Wellspring acquired the group in 2008. Today the business runs as a PFG subsidiary serving the Rocky Mountain region.

The distributor runs a 350,000-square-foot facility staffed by more than 1,000 employees. Its catalog holds 15,000 to 25,000 SKUs, including 3,500 locally sourced items and products from 750 brand partners such as Roma® and West Creek®. A dedicated fleet and logistics network achieve a 98 percent fill rate on customer orders. The PFS Express program adds daily deliveries across Colorado, Wyoming, and New Mexico with late cut-off times and no minimum-order requirement. Customers also use the Customer First Application for 24/7 ordering, tracking, and inventory management.

The company serves independent restaurants, chains, and institutional kitchens throughout Colorado, Wyoming, and New Mexico — roughly 5,000 accounts, 94 percent of which are small businesses. Segments include full-service restaurants, quick-service operators, healthcare foodservice, and educational institutions. The Culinology team provides menu development and recipe support alongside standard distribution.

PFG’s four stated values — Service Excellence, Innovation, Integrity, and Community Support — frame the Denver division’s approach. The business says it was built to solve supply-chain disruptions, labor shortages, and rising costs that threaten menu consistency and profitability for local operators.
